_comment: Settings for the CAGED reviewer pass (transcripts/ingest_cron.hardened.sh). A second, low-privilege claude -p that reads the staged diff + manifest and emits APPROVE / ESCALATE. It has NO tools that can act: no Bash, no Write/Edit, no web, no MCP, no secrets. It can only Read/Grep the review inputs. Being read-only, it cannot be steered into doing anything even if the diff contains injection; it is a screening layer on top of the deterministic bash gates, never the sole gate. See COE-2026-07-13-transcript-cron-injection-exposure.md.
